name: refusal-anchor-after-the-bound
note: An anchor after the rule's UNTIL is rejected outright by the rrule crate — the shape that once bricked a whole calendar (Deferno#428/#429).
error: RRule("RRule validation error: `UNTIL` is `2025-01-02T07:59:59+00:00`, but `DTSTART` (`2026-04-01T09:00:00-07:00`) is later. That should not be happening.")
